name: datavision-platform-week7

target_structure.data_engineering: Duy ingestion, handoff builders, database writer, validation

target_structure.ai/prediction: Tuong inference, safety policy, prediction log builder
target_structure.database: Phat schema, views, setup, smoke data, validation
target_structure.demo: Phi/Hung UI, services, fixtures, backend client

target_structure.tests: Module tests and shared contract tests
target_structure.scripts: CI smoke tests, handoff builders, integration checks
target_structure.deployment: Dockerfiles, database init, local and staging runbooks
target_structure.outputs: Versioned handoff JSON, UI fixtures, validation evidence

canonical_ids.source_id: Integer sources.id. Never use an ingestion run UUID here.
canonical_ids.document_external_id: Stable Duy/Lap/Tuong string key, for example doc_dataflow_technical_report.
canonical_ids.ingestion_run_id: Run UUID from Duy logs and pipeline_runs.
canonical_ids.document_id_in_database: Use documents.id for integer foreign keys after resolution.
